name: Payment dates in the future or beyond the backdating window are rejected
title: SC-09-04-05 Payment dates in the future or beyond the backdating window are rejected
description:
Verified by the test cases listed as steps. The Gherkin steps were not executed one by one.

Given a unit with open dues
When a payment is recorded with a date in the future or older than the backdating window
Then the request is rejected with 400 and no receipt is issued
